description_en: Retrieves the application status information of an edge container, including deployment, publishing, and rollback details
description_zh: 获取边缘容器的应用状态信息，包括应用的部署、发布、回滚等信息
name: GetEdgeContainerAppStatus

parameters.help_en: The application ID. You can call [ListEdgeContainerApps](~~ListEdgeContainerApps~~) to obtain the application ID. Before calling this operation, you must first activate the edge container service by calling OpenEdgeContainer, and then confirm that an available application exists by calling ListEdgeContainerApps or create an application by calling CreateEdgeContainerApp
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID，可使用[ListEdgeContainerApps](~~ListEdgeContainerApps~~)接口获取应用ID。调用该接口需先通过 OpenEdgeContainer 开通边缘容器服务，并通过 ListEdgeContainerApps 确认存在可用应用或通过 CreateEdgeContainerApp 创建应用
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The publishing environment. Valid values: prod and staging
parameters.help_zh: 发布环境，支持"prod","staging"两种发布环境
parameters.name: publish_env

AppStatus.description_en: The object that describes the application status information
AppStatus.description_zh: 描述应用状态信息的对象

BaseLineVersion.description_en: The baseline version of the application

DeployStatus.description_en:
The deployment status of the application. Valid values:
undeploy: Not deployed.
deploying: Being deployed.
deployed: Deployed.
undeploying: Being undeployed
DeployStatus.description_zh:
应用的部署状态。
undeploy：未部署。
deploying：部署中。
deployed：已部署。
undeploying：取消部署中

DeployTime.description_en: The deployment time of the application. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
DeployTime.description_zh: 应用的部署时间，日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

DeployedVersion.description_en: The deployed version of the application

ExpectPercentage.description_en: The expected publishing percentage of the application

FullRelease.description_en: Indicates whether the application is fully released. This field takes effect only when PublishType is set to region
FullRelease.description_zh: 是否全量发布。该字段仅当 PublishType设置为 region 时生效

PublishEnv.description_en:
The publishing environment. Valid values:

prod: Production environment.
staging: Staging environment
PublishEnv.description_zh:
发布的环境，取值如下：

prod: 生产环境。
staging：预发环境

PublishPercentage.description_en: The publishing percentage of the application

PublishStatus.description_en:
The publishing status of the application. Valid values:
publishing: Being published.
published: Published.
rollbacking: Being rolled back.
rollbacked: Rolled back
PublishStatus.description_zh:
应用的发布状态。
publishing：发布中。
published：已发布。
rollbacking：回滚中。
rollbacked：回滚完成

PublishTime.description_en: The publishing time of the application. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
PublishTime.description_zh: 应用的发布时间，日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

PublishType.description_en:
The publishing type. Valid values:

percentage: Publish by percentage.

region: Publish by region.

If this parameter is not specified, the default value percentage is used
PublishType.description_zh:
发布类型，支持如下两种：

percentage：按照百分比发布。

region：按照区域发布。

若不填写，默认使用百分比发布

PublishingVersion.description_en: The publishing version of the application

RollbackTime.description_en: The most recent rollback time. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
RollbackTime.description_zh: 最近一次回滚时间。日期格式按照 ISO8601 表示法，并使用 UTC 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

UnDeployTime.description_en: The undeployment time of the application. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
UnDeployTime.description_zh: 应用的取消部署时间，日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
